title: Sub-document byte-span entailment and transitive retraction propagation
claim_boundary: Source-verified specification and granular execution playbook only; sub-document byte-span entailment verification and transitive retraction poisoning remain open implementation gates. Path presence is not behavioural proof; assertion-level traceability governs implementation claims.

assertions.statement: Proof-carrying sub-document anchor contract binding extracted claims to `doc_sha256`, page index, UTF-8 byte range, bounding box and verbatim quote digest
open_gates: Define PdfBoundingBox, ProofCarryingSpan, GroundedClaim, IntegrityNotice, and SynthesisQuarantineFlag contracts in crates/searchright-contracts/src/document.rs and crates/searchright-contracts/src/study.rs.
Implement deterministic UTF-8 byte-slice verification and negation-aware claim entailment checking in crates/searchright-citeweft/src/lib.rs.
Implement transitive retraction and expression-of-concern poisoning across Report-to-Study-to-Synthesis graphs in crates/searchright-study/src/lib.rs and crates/searchright-living/src/lib.rs.
Add end-to-end span-tampering rejection and post-inclusion retraction quarantine tests across study synthesis and PRISMA living flow outputs.
assertions.permitted_claim: Scaffolding exists; behaviour is not claimed.
